text: I am Dr. Agent. To begin my assessment of this newborn with respiratory distress, could you please describe the specific symptoms observed at birth and any relevant maternal history?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born at 33 weeks of gestation. The newborn is presenting with respiratory distress 2 hours after birth. The mother had an uneventful pregnancy until premature onset of labor. There was no significant prenatal care history mentioned.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the premature birth at 33 weeks and rapid onset of respiratory distress, this presentation is highly suggestive of surfactant deficiency. I will request a chest X-ray to look for characteristic ground-glass opacities and a complete blood count to rule out infection. REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray REQUEST TEST: CBC
